methodology.stopRule: First independent structural tenpai after a discard, or draw budget; already-tenpai initial hands stop at zero.
methodology.oracle: Independent enumeration of legal completed suit targets with four-copy limits, plus distinct seven pairs and thirteen orphans; public unseen counts only.
methodology.regret: Reference efficiency opportunity cost, not a mistake rate: does not optimize hand value, future shape, furiten or risk.
methodology.score: Final source-engine expected closed/riichi score, not an independent score or settled points.
methodology.timing: Awaited source decisions with source caches reset per turn; reference-oracle time excluded. Fixed fixture setup/invariant checks are outside timings.
methodology.limitations: This is not self-play or win rate. Only own draws advance the wall; zero opponent threat. Paired versions share the identical hidden physical wall and alternate execution order per seed/mode.
